second_source.rule: one step up (reject->doubtful->likely->confirmed) when Spareto lists the same (part_no, rival number) pair under an agreeing brand; never down. Spareto's upstream data source is not stated on its pages: independent of Eucon as a pipeline, not proven independent upstream.
second_source.spareto_only_rows: merged into this file as tier doubtful, edge_origin=spareto_only, single source; not trusted for price comparison until a second source confirms them

brand_aliases.rule: spellings in the table count as one brand in the Spareto brand check and the brand-collision trap; exact canonical match, no containment

data_boundary: 100% of the rival edges from the cross-reference graph are Eucon-sourced (rows with edge_origin=spareto_only are not). Jerome's standing rule bars Eucon rows from DeepSeek or any outside-EU service, so the plan's original method for this card (DeepSeek pro, prompt 6.2) was NOT used. Grading is local and deterministic.
method_limit: This separates safe edges from doubtful ones. It cannot confirm a match the way a human or a language model could, and a 'confirmed' tier means corroborated by independent source files — not verified against a manufacturer catalogue.
